headline: Petronas Chemicals Q3 Earnings Moderate on Lower Petrochemical Product Prices
summary: Petronas Chemicals Group reported lower third-quarter net earnings as softer global petrochemical selling prices weighed on revenue.
why: Petronas Chemicals is Southeast Asia's leading integrated chemical producer, listed on Bursa Malaysia.

impacts.name: Petronas Chemicals Group
impacts.why: Petronas Chemicals reported lower Q3 earnings due to weaker product prices.
